title: Asthma education instruction.
bodyText:
(a) The department may offer optional asthma self-management instruction to students with asthma. The instruction shall be age-appropriate and the topics shall include:

(1) Asthma facts, physiology, and early warning signs;

(2) Symptoms and triggers of asthma; and

(3) Asthma self-management skills.

(b) The department may coordinate with any public or private entity to provide the instruction offered under this section.

(c) The department may use existing educational and training resources available in the public and private sectors when developing the instruction offered under this section.
